what_it_does: Where the cell cursor goes after a commit (aaNone, aaDown, aaRight, aaLeft, aaRightDown, aaLeftDown, aaRightUp, aaLeftUp), with a separate direction for the Tab key.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'AutoAdvance\|TabAdvance' over source/ returned nothing. Our key handling hard-codes the movement (VK_TAB at Grid.pas:7262); the only navigation knob published is SkipReadOnlyCells (Grid.pas:2175).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1222 'property AutoAdvance: TAutoAdvance ... default aaRight', :1273 'property TabAdvance ... default aaRightDown'; enum at :146-147.
user_impact: Data-entry grids that must advance down a column after Enter (the classic ledger pattern) cannot be configured - the host has to intercept keys itself.

what_it_does: When True a plain click on the focused cell opens the editor straight away; when False editing needs F2 / a second click.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'AutoEdit' over source/ returned nothing. Ours exposes only BeginEdit/EndEdit (Grid.pas:1910-1913) and ReadOnly (2192); the click-to-edit policy is fixed in the mouse handler.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1223 'property AutoEdit: boolean read FAutoEdit write FAutoEdit default true', published on TDrawGrid (:1600) / TStringGrid (:1845).
user_impact: A grid used mainly for browsing cannot suppress accidental edit-on-click, and a fast-entry grid cannot turn it on.

what_it_does: Distributes all spare width across every column proportionally, honouring each column's MinSize/MaxSize/SizePriority.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'AutoFillColumns' over source/ returned nothing. The nearest thing is hoAutoResize + Header.AutoSizeIndex, which grows ONE column (Grid.pas:3315-3318). TTyColumns.DistributeSpring (Columns.pas:161) is the multi-column algorithm and has ZERO call sites anywhere - grep 'DistributeSpring' over source/ returns only its own declaration (161) and body (709); coAutoSpring is likewise never read outside Columns.pas.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1224 'property AutoFillColumns: boolean read FAutoFillColumns write SetAutoFillColumns default false'; published on TDrawGrid (:1601) / TStringGrid (:1846); helper CalcAutoSizeColumn at :987.
user_impact: A grid that should share its width across all columns on resize can only fatten one designated column; the spring code we already have is unreachable from any control.

what_it_does: THEIRS: the pen style of the grid lines (psSolid, psDash, psDot, psDashDot...). OURS: which AXES get lines (glsNone/glsHorizontal/glsVertical/glsBoth). Same identifier, unrelated meaning and incompatible type.
ours_evidence: Grid.pas:1242 'property GridLineStyle: TTyGridLineStyle ... default glsBoth'; type declared Grid.pas:193 as (glsNone, glsHorizontal, glsVertical, glsBoth). grep over source/ found no TPenStyle grid-line property; dashed grid lines are not implementable.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1266 'property GridLineStyle: TPenStyle read FGridLineStyle write SetGridLineStyle default psSolid'; the axis question is answered by goVertLine/goHorzLine/goFixedVertLine/goFixedHorzLine in Options (:87-90).
user_impact: The worst kind of porting break: GridLineStyle := psDot compiles-fails, and a .lfm carrying GridLineStyle=psDash streams into our enum by ordinal and silently means 'horizontal lines only'. Also: no dotted/dashed grid, and no way to line the fixed area differently from the body.

what_it_does: Read/write index of the first visible column / row - the scroll position expressed in CELLS, which is how grid code scrolls ('TopRow := 500').
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'LeftCol' over source/ returned nothing; 'TopRow' hits only the unrelated ScrollHintFor(ATopRow) parameter (Grid.pas:1688, 12190). Our scroll state is ScrollX/ScrollY in device pixels and both are **protected** (Grid.pas:1096-1097); the only public positioning call is ScrollIntoView (1203).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1278 'property LeftCol:Integer read GetLeftCol write SetLeftCol', :1297 'property TopRow: Integer read GetTopRow write SetTopRow'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1483, :1492).
user_impact: Saving and restoring a user's scroll position, or jumping the view to a row without moving the cursor, has no API - and reading the current first visible row is impossible from outside.

what_it_does: Read-only total pixel extent of all columns / rows - what you compare against ClientWidth to know whether the content overflows.
ours_evidence: Ours are ContentWidthPx / ContentHeightPx and both are **protected** (Grid.pas:1101-1102), so a host cannot read them. grep -ri 'GridWidth\|GridHeight' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1264 'property GridHeight: Integer read FGCache.GridHeight', :1268 'property GridWidth: Integer read FGCache.GridWidth'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1480-1481).
user_impact: A host that wants to size a panel to the grid's content, or decide whether scrolling is needed, has to re-sum the column widths itself.

what_it_does: THEIRS: how many rows currently fit in the viewport (a viewport metric, used for PageUp/PageDown maths). OURS: how many data rows pass the filter (a data metric).
ours_evidence: Grid.pas:2017 'function VisibleRowCount: Integer' with the comment '通过过滤的行数(= 当前显示的行数)' - it counts filtered-in rows, not on-screen rows. Our viewport metrics are ViewportW/ViewportH in pixels and are protected (Grid.pas:1111-1112).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1301 'property VisibleRowCount: Integer read GetVisibleRowCount stored false'; republished on TCustomDrawGrid (:1538) and published on TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:248).
user_impact: Ported code that scrolls by VisibleRowCount pages silently computes garbage - with 10000 filtered-in rows it will page 10000 rows at a time. The name collides while meaning something else.

what_it_does: How many columns currently fit in the viewport.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'VisibleColCount' over source/ returned nothing; we have no column-axis counterpart at all (FirstVisibleCol/LastVisibleCol at Grid.pas:943-944 answer 'not hidden', not 'on screen').
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1300 'property VisibleColCount: Integer read GetVisibleColCount stored false'; republished on TCustomDrawGrid (:1537).
user_impact: Horizontal paging and 'how much of the grid is the user actually seeing' cannot be answered.

what_it_does: Read AND write the selection rectangle in one property; assigning it moves the selection (and, with goSelectionActive, the cursor too).
ours_evidence: Ours is a read-only FUNCTION: Grid.pas:1942 'function Selection: TRect'. Writing is a separate method, SelectRange(ACol1,ARow1,ACol2,ARow2) (Grid.pas:1930) / SelectRows (1931).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1292 'property Selection: TGridRect read GetSelection write SetSelection'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1489).
user_impact: 'Grid.Selection := R' - a normal LCL idiom, including round-tripping a saved rect - has to be rewritten as SelectRange with four arguments.

what_it_does: Chooses rsmSingle (one selection rectangle) or rsmMulti (Ctrl-click builds several disjoint rectangles).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'RangeSelectMode' over source/ returned nothing. We ALWAYS support disjoint multi-select - FSelRects is a private array (Grid.pas:1531-1535) filled by Ctrl+click (Grid.pas:7030-7038) - with no way to restrict it to a single range.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1282 'property RangeSelectMode: TRangeSelectMode read FRangeSelectMode write SetRangeSelectMode default rsmSingle'; enum at :150; published on TDrawGrid (:1647) / TStringGrid (:1892).
user_impact: An app whose logic assumes exactly one selected block (the LCL default) gets multi-range behaviour it cannot switch off, and its 'the selection' code silently sees only the last block.

what_it_does: Enumerate the disjoint selection rectangles: how many there are, each one's TGridRect, and a quick 'is more than one thing selected'.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'SelectedRange\|SelectedRangeCount\|HasMultiSelection' over source/ returned nothing. The data exists but is private: FSelRects (Grid.pas:1535). The only public readers are Selection (1942, 'discrete multi-select: only the last block'), SelectedCellCount (1944) and IsCellSelected (1917).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1377 'property SelectedRange[AIndex: Integer]: TGridRect read GetSelectedRange', :1378 'property SelectedRangeCount', :1356 'function HasMultiSelection: Boolean'.
user_impact: We let the user Ctrl-click several blocks and then give the host no way to find out what they picked - a host iterating 'the selection' processes only the last rectangle and silently drops the rest.

what_it_does: Drops all committed selection ranges (plural - the multi-select list).
ours_evidence: Ours is singular: Grid.pas:1940 'procedure ClearSelection'. grep -ri 'ClearSelections' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1343 'procedure ClearSelections;'.
user_impact: One-character porting break on a routinely-called method.

what_it_does: Read/write flag saying a rubber-band selection is in progress; setting it starts/stops range extension from code (what Shift+arrow does internally).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'SelectActive' over source/ returned nothing. Ours has the private FExtendingSelection (Grid.pas:1499) and the public AnchorSelection (1919), but no readable/writable 'extending now' state.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1288 'property SelectActive: Boolean read FSelectActive write SetSelectActive'.
user_impact: Code that drives selection extension programmatically (e.g. a 'select to end' command) cannot put the grid into extend mode.

what_it_does: Read-only shortcut to the column object under the cursor.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'SelectedColumn' over source/ hits only colour pickers (ColorButton, HSColorPicker, LColorPicker). Ours has the protected GridColumn(ACol) (Grid.pas:932) and Col (2188), so the host must write GridColumn-equivalent casts itself: TTyGridColumn(Header.Columns.Items[Col]).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1291 'property SelectedColumn: TGridColumn read GetSelectedColumn'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1488).
user_impact: 'if Grid.SelectedColumn.ReadOnly then...' needs a manual index-and-cast, and the helper that would do it (GridColumn) is protected.

what_it_does: Draw the selection dimmed when the grid does not have focus.
ours_evidence: Ours is HideSelectionWhenInactive (Grid.pas:1147-1149), and it sits in a **public** (not published) section opened at Grid.pas:1119 - so it does not stream from a .lfm. grep -ri 'FadeUnfocusedSelection' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1290 'property FadeUnfocusedSelection: boolean ... default false'; published on TDrawGrid (:1623) / TStringGrid (:1868).
user_impact: Different name plus not designer-settable: a ported .lfm fails on the property, and the ty equivalent cannot be set in the Object Inspector.

what_it_does: Whether the focus rectangle is drawn around the current cell.
ours_evidence: Ours is ShowFocusCell (Grid.pas:1144-1145, 'default True'), again in the **public** not published section (Grid.pas:1119). grep -ri 'FocusRectVisible' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1261 'property FocusRectVisible: Boolean ... default true'; published on TDrawGrid (:1629) / TStringGrid (:1874).
user_impact: Ported .lfm breaks, and the ty property is invisible in the designer.

what_it_does: Read/write property: setting True opens the in-place editor on the current cell, False closes it; reading tells you whether it is open.
ours_evidence: Ours splits it: Editing is read-only (Grid.pas:2182) and opening/closing are methods BeginEdit / EndEdit(ACommit) (Grid.pas:1910-1913). grep -ri 'EditorMode' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1245 'property EditorMode: Boolean read FEditorMode write EditorSetMode'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1473) and TCustomStringGrid (:1823).
user_impact: 'Grid.EditorMode := True' is the standard way to drop into edit mode from a toolbar button; it needs rewriting, and there is no single settable property to bind to.

what_it_does: Editor is READ/WRITE: assign any TWinControl (or one produced by EditorByStyle) and the grid drives it as the cell editor. InplaceEditor is the read-only view of the same field.
ours_evidence: Ours exposes Editor as a concrete read-only TTyEdit (Grid.pas:2183), PickEditor as TTyComboBox (2184) and the generic read-only EditorControl: TControl (2099). Installing a foreign editor goes through the TTyGridEditLink class (Grid.pas:131-142) + OnCreateEditLink (2242) - a different, non-assignable protocol. grep -ri 'InplaceEditor' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1243 'property Editor: TWinControl read FEditor write SetEditor', :1276 'property InplaceEditor: TWinControl read FEditor'; republished on TCustomDrawGrid (:1471) and TDrawGrid (:1594).
user_impact: Code that does 'Grid.Editor := MyCombo' - the documented LCL way to plug in a custom editor - has to be rewritten as an EditLink subclass; and 'Editor' on our side means something narrower (a TTyEdit) than the same identifier on theirs.

what_it_does: Let the user grab a column/row divider anywhere in the BODY, not only in the header/indicator strip.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ExtendedColSizing\|ExtendedRowSizing' over source/ returned nothing. Ours restricts divider hits by construction: DividerAtX only inside the header (Grid.pas:3579 'and (Y < hdrH)') and RowDividerAtY only inside the indicator gutter (Grid.pas:4014-4015).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1249-1250; ExtendedColSizing republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1474).
user_impact: On a grid with no header band (or no indicator) the user has nowhere to grab and can never resize a column or row.

what_it_does: Whether Shift+click / Shift+arrow extends the selection at all.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ExtendedSelect' over source/ returned nothing; Shift-extension is unconditional in our key/mouse handling (FExtendingSelection, Grid.pas:1499).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1251 'property ExtendedSelect: boolean ... default true'; republished on TCustomStringGrid (:1824), published on TDrawGrid (:1622) / TStringGrid (:1867).
user_impact: A single-cell-only grid cannot forbid range selection.

what_it_does: Typing a printable character on a focused cell immediately opens the editor and seeds it with that character (spreadsheet type-over).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'FastEditing' over source/ returned nothing; no such toggle exists on our editing path (BeginEdit at Grid.pas:1910).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1252 'property FastEditing: boolean read FFastEditing write FFastEditing'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1476).
user_impact: Data-entry users cannot get (or turn off) the Excel-like 'just start typing' behaviour.

what_it_does: Which fixed zones (gzFixedCols, gzFixedRows, gzFixedCells) hot-track under the mouse and which render pushed while clicked.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'HeaderHotZones\|HeaderPushZones\|GridZone' over source/ returned nothing. The nearest concept, hoHotTrack, IS declared (Columns.pas:41) but the grid never reads it - grep 'hoHotTrack' over tyControls.Grid.pas returns nothing (the grid reads only hoVisible/hoColumnResize/hoDrag/hoShowSortGlyphs/hoHeaderClickAutoSort/hoAutoResize). Our pressed-state tracking (FPressedBtnCol/Row, Grid.pas:1667-1669) is for BUTTON CELLS, not header sections.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1269-1270; zone enum at :143-144; flags goHeaderHotTracking/goHeaderPushedLook at :109-110. Published on TDrawGrid (:1634-1635) / TStringGrid (:1879-1880).
user_impact: Header sections never highlight on hover and never look pressed on click, so the header does not read as clickable - and the hoHotTrack flag a user sets in the Object Inspector silently does nothing.

what_it_does: Take the ascending/descending sort glyph from TitleImageList by index instead of drawing the built-in triangle.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ImageIndexSortAsc\|ImageIndexSortDesc' over source/ returned nothing. Our sort glyph is drawn by the grid gated on hoShowSortGlyphs (Grid.pas:5001, 5076, 5131) with no image substitution hook.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1271-1272 '... default -1'; published on TDrawGrid (:1636-1637) / TStringGrid (:1881-1882).
user_impact: An app with its own icon set cannot make the grid's sort arrows match the rest of its chrome.

what_it_does: A dedicated image list for column-title icons, plus a width used to pick the right resolution at high DPI.
ours_evidence: Ours has ONE Images: TTyVirtualImageList (Grid.pas:1253) shared by header icons and gcdImage cells - the comment at Grid.pas:735-738 says so explicitly. TTyHeader.Images (Columns.pas:216) is published but the grid never reads it (grep 'Header.Images' over Grid.pas returns nothing). grep -ri 'TitleImageList\|TitleImageListWidth' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1274-1275; published on TDrawGrid (:1656-1657) / TStringGrid (:1901).
user_impact: Header icons and cell images must come from the same list, so they cannot be sized independently; and the published Header.Images property is dead - anything a user assigns there is ignored.

what_it_does: Whether the wheel moves the cell CURSOR (mwCursor) or scrolls the GRID (mwGrid).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'MouseWheelOption' over source/ returned nothing; DoMouseWheel (Grid.pas:1106) always scrolls the view.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1279 'property MouseWheelOption: TMouseWheelOption ... default mwCursor'; enum at :176; published on TDrawGrid (:1638) / TStringGrid (:1883) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:231).
user_impact: LCL's DEFAULT is mwCursor, so a ported grid's wheel behaviour changes silently - and cursor-moving wheel cannot be had at all.

what_it_does: Automatically hints the FULL text of a cell whose text is truncated, and chooses how that combines with the control Hint and OnGetCellHint (chpAll / chpAllNoDefault / chpTruncOnly).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'CellHintPriority\|TruncCellHint' over source/ returned nothing. Our hint path only asks OnGetCellHint or shows a cell comment and bails otherwise (Grid.pas:8526 'if (not Assigned(FOnGetCellHint)) and (not FHasComments) then Exit'), while our own TyGridEllipsisFit (Grid.pas:2347) truncates text with '...' - so the truncated text is never recoverable by hovering.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1227 'property CellHintPriority ... default chpAllNoDefault', enum + comment at :178-182, flag goTruncCellHints at :115, helper GetTruncCellHintText at :1124. Published on TStringGrid (:1850).
user_impact: Narrow columns clip their content to '...' and the user has no way to read it - the single most-noticed missing affordance in a grid with fixed column widths.

member: SaveToFile / LoadFromFile + SaveOptions: TSaveOptions + OnSaveColumn / OnLoadColumn
what_it_does: Persist the whole grid to an XML file and read it back, choosing what to include (soDesign = col/row count and Options, soAttributes = font/brush/text style, soContent = cell text, soPosition = cursor and selection), with per-column hooks so an app can add its own column attributes.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'SaveOptions\|OnSaveColumn\|OnLoadColumn' over source/ returned nothing. Ours offers SaveLayoutToString / LoadLayoutFromString (Grid.pas:2086-2087) which cover only widths, order, visibility, sort keys and freeze counts (its own comment says row heights are deliberately excluded), plus CSV/HTML/JSON export (2131-2155). The SaveToFile/LoadFromFile grep hits in Grid.pas (11225, 11581, 11593) are internal TStringList calls inside SaveToHTMLFile / SaveToCSVFile.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1364-1365, :1371-1372, :1287 'property SaveOptions: TSaveOptions', enum at :131-137, hooks at :1325-1326.
user_impact: 'Grid.SaveToFile(f) / LoadFromFile(f)' - the one-line way to persist a whole grid including its content and cursor - has no counterpart; the host must roll its own format and cannot round-trip attributes or cursor position at all.

what_it_does: THEIRS: writes/reads the full grid state as XMLConfig (structure + attributes + content + position, gated by SaveOptions). OURS: same names, but the payload is plain CSV text with a delimiter.
ours_evidence: Grid.pas:2154-2155 'procedure SaveToStream(AStream: TStream; ADelimiter: Char = #39,#39)' / LoadFromStream - the comment at 2150-2153 says it is deliberately the CSV path, UTF-8 no BOM.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1365 'procedure LoadFromStream(AStream: TStream); virtual', :1372 'procedure SaveToStream(AStream: TStream); virtual'; implementation routes through SaveContent/LoadContent with TXMLConfig (:1174, :1147).
user_impact: Signature-compatible enough to compile in ported code but writes a completely different format, so a stream written by one and read by the other loses everything except cell text - and column layout/cursor silently vanish.

what_it_does: THEIRS: ClearRows/ClearCols DELETE all non-fixed rows/columns (structure) and return Boolean 'anything changed'. OURS: same two names take (AFrom, ACount) and blank the cell CONTENT of a range, returning nothing.
ours_evidence: Grid.pas:1904-1905 'procedure ClearRows(AFrom, ACount: Integer); procedure ClearCols(AFrom, ACount: Integer)' - documented at 1869-1872 as clearing a band of cells through SetCells so it lands in the undo stack.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1340-1341 'function ClearCols: Boolean; function ClearRows: Boolean'; bodies at :10285-10300 set FRows.Count:=0 and FFixedRows:=0.
user_impact: The most dangerous kind of collision: 'if Grid.ClearRows then' fails to compile in the good case, and any wrapper that calls ClearRows expecting the grid to empty out instead clears a two-cell band. Also, no method exists to drop all rows/columns.

what_it_does: Empties the whole grid: removes non-fixed rows AND columns and their content in one call.
ours_evidence: Ours is ClearCells (Grid.pas:1868, documented '清空全部单元格内容(不动行列结构)' - content only, structure untouched). grep for a plain 'procedure Clear;' on TTyStringGrid returns nothing (TTyValueListEditor has one, ValueListEditor.pas:177).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1342 'procedure Clear;'; body at :10302-10316 calls ClearRows + ClearCols.
user_impact: Grid.Clear - probably the single most-typed grid call - does not exist, and the nearest name does something narrower, so a port that maps Clear->ClearCells leaves the old columns behind.

what_it_does: Repaint exactly one cell, one column, one row, or a rectangle of cells.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'InvalidateCell\|InvalidateRange' over source/ returned nothing; 'InvalidateCol'/'InvalidateRow' hit only InvalidateColumnCache (Grid.pas:974 - a geometry cache, not a repaint) and InvalidateRowMetrics (913 - a prefix-sum cache). The only repaint entry point is the whole-control Invalidate (Grid.pas:976).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1358-1361 'procedure InvalidateCell(aCol, aRow: Integer); overload; procedure InvalidateCol(ACol: Integer); procedure InvalidateRange(const aRange: TRect); procedure InvalidateRow(ARow: Integer);' (plus the protected 3-arg InvalidateCell at :1132).
user_impact: A host that changes one cell from a timer or a socket must repaint the entire grid; on a big grid that is the difference between a smooth live view and a flickering one.

what_it_does: Boolean: is this cell currently within the visible area (and the fixed-area variant).
ours_evidence: Ours only offers the geometry: CellVisibleRect (Grid.pas:1178) which the caller must test for emptiness. grep -ri 'IsCellVisible' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1362-1363 'function IsCellVisible(aCol, aRow: Integer): Boolean; function IsFixedCellVisible(aCol, aRow: Integer): boolean;'.
user_impact: 'only update rows the user can see' loops must be written as IsRectEmpty(CellVisibleRect(...)) - correct but non-obvious, and a port breaks.

what_it_does: The whole family of point-to-cell and cell-to-zone conversions, including a two-out-parameter MouseToCell overload and the zone (gzNormal / gzFixedCols / gzFixedRows / gzFixedCells / gzInvalid) at a point.
ours_evidence: Ours condenses all of it into CellAt(AX,AY): TTyGridHit (Grid.pas:1199) plus CellPane(ACol,APos): TTyGridPane (Grid.pas:1170). grep -ri 'MouseToCell\|MouseCoord\|MouseToLogcell\|CellToGridZone\|GridZone' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1338 'function CellToGridZone', :1366 'function MouseCoord', :1367-1368 MouseToCell overloads, :1369 MouseToLogcell, :1370 MouseToGridZone.
user_impact: Every context-menu / drag-and-drop handler in ported code calls MouseToCell; all of them must be rewritten, and the return types differ (TTyGridHit record vs TPoint / out params).

what_it_does: Auto-fit EVERY column to its content in one call (LCL has both the TCustomGrid virtual and the string-grid pair AutoSizeColumn / AutoSizeColumns).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'AutoAdjustColumns\|AutoSizeColumn' over source/ returned nothing. Ours has only the singular AutoFitColumn(ACol) (Grid.pas:1864) and AutoFitColumnWidth(ACol) (1865); note that the ROW axis DOES have the plural (AutoFitRows, Grid.pas:1925), so the asymmetry is ours.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1335 'procedure AutoAdjustColumns; virtual', :1803-1804 'procedure AutoSizeColumn(aCol: Integer); procedure AutoSizeColumns;'.
user_impact: 'fit all columns to the data I just loaded' - the normal thing to do after LoadFromCSV - needs a host loop, and the obvious AutoSizeColumns name is missing while AutoFitRows exists.

what_it_does: The IsColumn-parameterised structural family, so one call site handles both axes, plus the singular DeleteCol name.
ours_evidence: Ours names them per-axis with no IsColumn form: InsertRow/DeleteRow (Grid.pas:1841-1842), InsertColumn/DeleteColumn (1843-1844), InsertRows/RemoveRows/InsertCols/RemoveCols (1851-1854), MoveRow/SwapRows/MoveColumn (1856-1858). grep -ri 'DeleteColRow\|InsertColRow\|ExchangeColRow\|MoveColRow' over source/ returned nothing; there is no ExchangeColumns at all (SwapRows has no column twin).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1453-1458 'procedure DeleteColRow(IsColumn: Boolean; index: Integer); procedure DeleteCol(Index: Integer); virtual; ... procedure ExchangeColRow(...); procedure InsertColRow(...); procedure MoveColRow(...)'.
user_impact: Generic 'delete whichever axis the user picked' code must be un-generalised; DeleteCol->DeleteColumn is a silent compile break; and swapping two COLUMNS has no method at all.

what_it_does: Sort by a ROW - i.e. reorder the COLUMNS according to the values in one row - and the range-limited overload SortColRow(IsColumn, Index, FromIndex, ToIndex).
ours_evidence: Ours sorts rows only: SortByColumn (Grid.pas:2158), ToggleSortColumn (2160), AddSortColumn (2163). grep -ri 'SortColRow' over source/ returned nothing, and no method takes a row index as the sort key.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1459-1460 'procedure SortColRow(IsColumn: Boolean; index:Integer); overload; procedure SortColRow(IsColumn: Boolean; Index,FromIndex,ToIndex: Integer); overload;'; the protected virtual Sort(ColSorting: Boolean; ...) at :1200.
user_impact: Transposed / matrix-style grids cannot be sorted along the other axis, and no sort can be limited to a sub-range of rows.

what_it_does: Lets an OnDrawCell handler call the grid's own default painting for that cell, then draw on top of it.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'DefaultDrawCell' over source/ returned nothing. Our OnDrawCell (Grid.pas:2266, type at 101-102) is all-or-nothing: the host sets AHandled:=True and the control 'does not draw its content'. There is no callable default-content painter (RenderCells is protected, Grid.pas:1082).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1462 'procedure DefaultDrawCell(aCol,aRow: Integer; var aRect: TRect; aState:TGridDrawState); virtual;'.
user_impact: The common 'draw the normal cell, then stamp an icon in the corner' pattern forces the host to re-implement text drawing, alignment and ellipsis from scratch.

what_it_does: One switch that turns off the grid's own cell painting so OnDrawCell owns every cell.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'DefaultDrawing' over source/ returned nothing; ours is decided per cell by the AHandled out-parameter of OnDrawCell (Grid.pas:101-102, 2266).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1239 'property DefaultDrawing: Boolean read FDefaultDrawing write SetDefaultDrawing default True'; published on TDrawGrid (:1615) / TStringGrid (:1860) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:217).
user_impact: A fully custom-painted grid must set AHandled in every callback instead of flipping one design-time flag - and it cannot be expressed in a .lfm.

what_it_does: The TTextStyle record (alignment, layout, single-line, word-break, clipping, opaque, show-prefix...) applied to every cell unless overridden.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'DefaultTextStyle' over source/ returned nothing. We have the grid-wide WordWrap boolean (Grid.pas:1247) and per-cell HAlign/VAlign supplied only through the OnGetCellStyle event (Grid.pas:518-521); the base appearance hard-codes VAlign := tlCenter (Grid.pas:4256) and there is no default horizontal alignment property.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1240 'property DefaultTextStyle: TTextStyle read FDefaultTextStyle write FDefaultTextStyle'; republished public on TCustomStringGrid (:1822).
user_impact: 'centre every cell in this grid' requires wiring an event handler; there is no default alignment/layout setting at all.

what_it_does: Which cursor to show while resizing a column (crHSplit), resizing a row (crVSplit) or dragging a col/row (crMultiDrag), and the colour of the drag insert indicator.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ColSizingCursor\|RowSizingCursor\|ColRowDraggingCursor\|ColRowDragIndicatorColor' over source/ returned nothing. Our cursor choice is hard-wired in UpdateHoverCursor (Grid.pas:876) with only the generic TControl.Cursor published by the base (Base.pas:229).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1231-1233, :1285; published on TDrawGrid (:1608-1610, :1649) / TStringGrid (:1853-1855, :1894).
user_impact: An app with a custom cursor set cannot make the grid's resize/drag cursors match, and the drag indicator colour is fixed.

what_it_does: Grid-level boolean: clicking a column header sorts by it.
ours_evidence: Ours expresses it as the header flag hoHeaderClickAutoSort (Columns.pas:37), read at Grid.pas:6992. grep -ri 'ColumnClickSorts' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1234 'property ColumnClickSorts: boolean read FColumnClickSorts write SetColumnClickSorts default false'; published on TDrawGrid (:1611) / TStringGrid (:1856).
user_impact: A one-line port (Grid.ColumnClickSorts := True) becomes 'Header.Options := Header.Options + [hoHeaderClickAutoSort]', which is not discoverable from the grid's own property list.

what_it_does: When False, MouseToCell-style coordinate translation refuses to report cells for points outside the grid, so drag handlers do not get phantom cells.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'AllowOutboundEvents' over source/ returned nothing; CellAt (Grid.pas:1199) has no such gate.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1220 'property AllowOutboundEvents: boolean ... default true'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1464).
user_impact: Drag-out-of-grid gestures cannot be clamped, so a host has to bounds-check every hit itself.

what_it_does: Forces a strict (total-order, no equal-keys shortcut) comparison during sorting.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'StrictSort' over source/ returned nothing. Our sort knobs are SortKind, BlanksPosition, SortIgnoreCase, SortMode, OnCompareCells (Grid.pas:2229-2238, 2298).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1294 'property StrictSort: boolean read FStrictSort write FStrictSort'; republished public on TCustomDrawGrid (:1490).
user_impact: Rows with equal keys can reorder unpredictably between sorts with no way to demand determinism.

what_it_does: Read/WRITE the current sort direction; assigning it flips the sort without naming a column.
ours_evidence: Ours is read-only: Grid.pas:2180 'property SortDirection: TTySortDirection read FSortDir' (no writer); changing direction requires SortByColumn(ACol, ADirection) (2158). SortColumn is likewise read-only (2161), matching theirs.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1379 'property SortOrder: TSortOrder read FSortOrder write FSortOrder' (writable), :1380 'property SortColumn: Integer read FSortColumn' (read-only); enum TSortOrder at :172.
user_impact: Different name and read-only: 'Grid.SortOrder := soDescending' cannot be ported, and there is no way to reverse the existing sort without re-specifying the column.

what_it_does: Clears the sort indicator from the header without changing the row order.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'HideSortArrow' over source/ returned nothing. Ours only has ClearSortColumns (Grid.pas:2164) and SortByColumn(-1) (2157-2158), both of which also DROP the sort and restore the original row order - so the arrow cannot be hidden while the order stands.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1357 'procedure HideSortArrow;'.
user_impact: Server-side-sorted grids (where the host sorted the data and only wants the glyph managed) cannot show or hide the arrow independently of our own sorting.

what_it_does: A whole column or row exposed as a live, ASSIGNABLE TStrings - 'Grid.Rows[3] := MyList', 'Memo.Lines := Grid.Cols[0]', Rows[r].CommaText, and per-cell Objects through it. The item class TStringGridStrings does not exist on our side at all.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'property Cols\|property Rows\|TStringGridStrings' over source/ returned nothing. Ours addresses only single cells: Cells[ACol,ARow] (Grid.pas:2185); bulk work goes through PasteFromText (2126) or LoadFromCSVText (2145).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1724-1746 (TStringGridStrings), :1821 'property Cols[index: Integer]: TStrings read GetCols write SetCols', :1826 'property Rows[index: Integer]: TStrings read GetRows write SetRows'.
user_impact: The whole idiom of filling or reading a grid row-at-a-time (and of piping a row into any TStrings consumer) is unavailable; every port has to be rewritten as a per-cell loop.

what_it_does: An arbitrary object pointer stored per cell alongside its text - the standard place to hang the record a row came from.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'Objects\[' over source/ hits only internal TStringList uses in the grid (attr store Grid.pas:2778, text cache 3762, row heights 3972, filter tally 9113). Nothing associates a TObject with a cell. Our per-cell payload (TTyGridCellAttr, Grid.pas:551-572) is a fixed record of appearance fields with no user slot; the only Tag is per-COLUMN (Columns.pas:97).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1825 'property Objects[ACol, ARow: Integer]: TObject read GetObjects write SetObjects'.
user_impact: 'which database record is this row?' has no storage; hosts must keep a parallel array keyed by row index and re-sync it on every insert, delete, sort and move - exactly the bookkeeping the grid already does for its own cells.

what_it_does: Read/write dirty flag set by any cell edit; the grid maintains it so the app can prompt 'save changes?'.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'Modified' over source/ hits only unrelated units (Controller, FileSystem, ShellListView). Our nearest signals are CanUndo / UndoCount (Grid.pas:2093, 2097), which are not the same thing (they survive a save, and are empty when UndoLimit=0).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1797 'property Modified: boolean read FModified write FModified' (protected on TCustomStringGrid), republished public on TStringGrid (:1838) and TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:200).
user_impact: Every host reimplements the dirty flag by hooking OnCellEdited, and any edit path we add later (paste, fill handle, undo) has to be remembered again in each app.

what_it_does: Insert a row and fill it from an open array in one call - the standard way to populate a string grid.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'InsertRowWithValues' over source/ returned nothing. Ours needs InsertRow(ARow) (Grid.pas:1841) followed by one Cells[c,r] assignment per column (2185).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1810 'procedure InsertRowWithValues(Index: Integer; Values: array of String);'; also on TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:189).
user_impact: Table-building code triples in length, and each row insert costs a separate undo/repaint cycle unless the host remembers BeginUpdate.

what_it_does: Four overloads that blank cell content, optionally restricted to a rectangle AND to grid zones (gzNormal / gzFixedCols / gzFixedRows / gzFixedCells) - so 'clear the data but keep the header captions' is one call.
ours_evidence: Ours are ClearCells (whole table, Grid.pas:1868), ClearRows(AFrom,ACount) and ClearCols(AFrom,ACount) (1904-1905). There is no rect form and no zone filter - grep -ri 'TGridZoneSet\|GridZone' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1805-1808 (four Clean overloads).
user_impact: Clearing a rectangular block needs nested loops, and 'clear data rows but not the fixed header row' cannot be expressed at all.

what_it_does: Copy the WHOLE grid, or just the selection, depending on the argument.
ours_evidence: Ours is CopySelectionToClipboard (Grid.pas:2124) - selection only - plus SelectionAsText (2123) and CutToClipboard (1860). grep -ri 'CopyToClipboard' over source/ hits only Edit.pas and Memo.pas. There is no 'copy the entire grid' entry point (the host must SelectAll first, which moves the user's selection).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1809 'procedure CopyToClipboard(AUseSelection: boolean = false);'.
user_impact: An 'Export all to clipboard' command has to disturb and then restore the user's selection.

what_it_does: CSV round-trip where the header row is OPTIONAL: WriteTitles=False emits data only, UseTitles=False treats line 0 as data.
ours_evidence: Our CSV writer ALWAYS emits the column captions as line 0 (Grid.pas:11451-11458, comment '表头一行(列标题)') and the reader ALWAYS consumes line 0 as titles (Grid.pas:11495-11505 '第一行当表头'). grep -ri 'UseTitles\|WriteTitles' over source/ returned nothing; SaveToCSVText (2131) / LoadFromCSVText (2145) / SaveToStream (2154) expose no such flag.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1811-1818 - 'UseTitles: boolean=true', 'WriteTitles: boolean=true'.
user_impact: Headerless CSV is impossible in both directions: exporting data-only for a downstream tool, and importing a file that has no header, which silently eats the first data row as captions.

what_it_does: Skip hidden columns when exporting; skip blank lines when importing.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'VisibleColumnsOnly\|SkipEmptyLines' over source/ returned nothing. Our exporter walks every column index in range (Grid.pas:11452-11457) with no coVisible check, even though we DO support hidden columns (HideColumn, Grid.pas:937; IsHiddenColumn, 939). Our importer has AIgnoreRows (a fixed count, Grid.pas:2146) but no blank-line skipping.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1815-1818 'VisibleColumnsOnly: boolean=false'; :1811-1814 'SkipEmptyLines: Boolean=true'.
user_impact: Exporting a grid whose columns the user hid still dumps the hidden data - a surprise and, for some data, a leak; and a CSV with blank separator lines imports phantom empty rows.

what_it_does: Fires whenever the first visible cell changes, i.e. on every scroll.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnTopLeftChanged\|OnScroll' over source/: the only grid hit is OnScrollHint (Grid.pas:2215), which asks the HOST for tooltip text while dragging the vertical thumb - it is not a scroll notification and does not fire for wheel, keyboard or ScrollIntoView scrolling. Nothing else notifies on scroll.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1315 'property OnTopLeftChanged: TNotifyEvent read FOnTopLeftChanged write FOnTopLeftChanged'; published on TDrawGrid (:1713) / TStringGrid (:1961) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:300).
user_impact: Anything that must track the viewport - a synchronised second grid, a lazy data fetch for the visible window, a scroll-position save - has no hook at all and must poll.

what_it_does: Three TOnSelectEvent hooks (Sender; aCol, aRow) around a selection change: before it commits, after it commits, and during rubber-banding.
ours_evidence: Ours has one OnSelectionChanged: TNotifyEvent (Grid.pas:2198) which carries no coordinates and fires only after; plus OnSelectCell (2190) which can veto a single cell. grep -ri 'OnBeforeSelection\|OnAfterSelection' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1303-1304 'property OnAfterSelection: TOnSelectEvent ... property OnBeforeSelection: TOnSelectEvent', :1313 'property OnSelection: TOnSelectEvent'.
user_impact: A handler must read Col/Row back off the grid instead of receiving them, cannot tell what the selection WAS, and gets no during-drag feedback - so live 'sum of selection' status bars update only on mouse-up.

what_it_does: Fires before each cell is drawn so the host can change Canvas.Brush / Font / TextStyle for that cell.
ours_evidence: Ours is OnGetCellStyle (Grid.pas:1255, type at 518-521) which hands over background/text colour/font name/size/weight/HAlign/VAlign by var-parameter rather than a canvas. grep -ri 'OnPrepareCanvas' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1307 'property OnPrepareCanvas: TOnPrepareCanvasEvent read FOnPrepareCanvas write FOnPrepareCanvas'; published on TDrawGrid (:1705) / TStringGrid (:1951) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:291).
user_impact: The single most commonly used TStringGrid event (conditional row colouring) is named differently and takes different parameters, so every ported handler must be rewritten; and there is no aState (gdSelected/gdFixed/gdHot/gdPushed) argument - the host has to infer state itself.

what_it_does: Fires when the user picks an item from a cell's drop-down pick list.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnPickListSelect' over source/ returned nothing. We have the picker itself (gekPickList, Grid.pas:79; PickList per column, 285; OnGetPickList, 2240) but the only completion signal is the generic OnCellEdited (2204), which cannot distinguish a pick from typed text.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1312 'property OnPickListSelect: TNotifyEvent read FOnPickListSelect write FOnPickListSelect'; published on TDrawGrid (:1704) / TStringGrid (:1950) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:290).
user_impact: Cascading drop-downs ('choose a country, now reload the city list') have no hook to trigger on.

what_it_does: Fires with (Sender; aCol, aRow; var Editor: TWinControl) so the host can swap in a different editor control for one cell by simple assignment.
ours_evidence: Ours splits it into OnCreateEditLink (Grid.pas:2242, which needs a TTyGridEditLink subclass, 131-142) and OnGetEditorProp (1272, which can only tweak the editor the grid already chose). grep -ri 'OnSelectEditor' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1314 'property OnSelectEditor: TSelectEditorEvent read FOnSelectEditor write FOnSelectEditor'; published on TDrawGrid (:1706) / TStringGrid (:1953) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:293).
user_impact: Swapping an editor per cell goes from a one-line var-assignment to writing and owning a class; a very common LCL pattern does not port mechanically.

what_it_does: Fires with (ACol, ARow; const OldValue; var NewValue): boolean - the host may rewrite the value or reject the edit, paired with ValidateOnSetSelection so the check also runs when the cursor is moved programmatically.
ours_evidence: Ours is OnCellEdited (Grid.pas:2204, type at 1386-1387: AOldText, ANewText, var AAccept) - close in spirit but a different name, and ANewText is 'const' so the handler can veto but NOT correct the value. grep -ri 'OnValidateEntry\|ValidateOnSetSelection' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1318 'property OnValidateEntry: TValidateEntryEvent ...', virtual at :1211; ValidateOnSetSelection at :1299.
user_impact: Ported validation handlers do not compile; and the 'normalise what the user typed' half of validation (trim, upcase, reformat a date) is impossible - only accept/reject is.

what_it_does: Four AFTER-the-fact structural notifications (IsColumn, index / FromIndex, ToIndex) so the host can keep its parallel data in step.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnColRow' over source/ returned nothing. All ours are BEFORE-and-veto: OnCanInsertRow / OnCanDeleteRow (Grid.pas:2209-2212), OnRowMove (1270), OnColumnMove (1268). Nothing fires after a row or column is actually inserted, deleted, moved or swapped - and SwapRows/MoveColumn (1857-1858) have no notification at all.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1543-1546; published on TDrawGrid (:1666-1669) / TStringGrid (:1912-1915) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:255-258).
user_impact: A host keeping its own array beside the grid gets told it MAY delete a row but never that the deletion happened, so it must guess or re-scan; and code ported from the LCL events silently stops running.

what_it_does: The editor's value is fetched from and written back to the host, letting the string shown in the editor differ from the cell's display text, and letting the grid edit data it does not store.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnGetEditText\|OnSetEditText' over source/ returned nothing. Ours reads the editor's seed value from Cells[] and commits through OnCellEdited (Grid.pas:2204); the display-only hook OnGetFormat (2221, 'only changes display - data, editor value and export all use the raw value') deliberately does NOT cover the editor.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1559-1560 'property OnGetEditMask: TGetEditEvent ...; property OnGetEditText: TGetEditEvent ...', :1580 OnSetEditText; published on TDrawGrid (:1686, :1710) / TStringGrid (:1932, :1957) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:272, 296).
user_impact: A virtual grid backed by the host's own data cannot be made editable through TTyDrawGrid at all, and 'edit the raw number while displaying a formatted one' has no hook.

what_it_does: Supplies a per-CELL edit mask on demand.
ours_evidence: Ours has only a per-COLUMN EditMask (Grid.pas:260, used with gekMask at 87). grep -ri 'OnGetEditMask' over source/ returned nothing, so the mask cannot vary by row.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1559; published on TDrawGrid (:1685) / TStringGrid (:1931) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:271).
user_impact: A settings-style grid where the mask depends on the row (phone here, postcode there) needs one column per format.

what_it_does: The host supplies and receives the checkbox state of a cell (TCheckboxState) instead of the grid deriving it from cell text.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnGetCheckboxState\|OnSetCheckboxState' over source/ returned nothing. Ours derives the state from the cell string - CellChecked / CellCheckState (Grid.pas:1877-1880) with a hard-coded truth vocabulary plus the global TyGridCheckedWord (Grid.pas:2308) - and only notifies afterwards via OnCheckBoxChange (2291).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1443-1446 (protected on TCustomDrawGrid), published on TDrawGrid (:1684, :1709) / TStringGrid (:1930, :1956).
user_impact: Checkbox columns must be backed by our string convention; a host holding real booleans cannot feed them in, and a virtual grid cannot have working checkboxes at all.

what_it_does: Let the host supply the bitmap / image-list entry used to draw a checkbox cell in a given state.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnUserCheckbox' over source/ returned nothing; our checkbox cells are drawn from the theme glyph path (TyDrawGlyph / --glyph-check, Base.pas:759) with no per-cell substitution hook.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1316-1317; published on TDrawGrid (:1714-1715) / TStringGrid (:1962-1963) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:301).
user_impact: Tri-state or domain-specific marks (a lock icon, a partial tick) cannot replace the standard check glyph per cell.

what_it_does: Fires for a click on a column header OR a row header, saying which axis it was.
ours_evidence: Ours is column-only: OnHeaderClick(Sender; ACol) (Grid.pas:1300, type TTyGridHeaderMouseEvent at 304) and OnHeaderRightClick (1301). There is no click event for the row indicator/row-number gutter at all - grep over Grid.pas for a row-header click event returns nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1561 'property OnHeaderClick: THdrEvent read FOnHeaderClick write FOnHeaderClick'; virtual HeaderClick(IsColumn, index) at :1127.
user_impact: 'user clicked row header 5 - select that record' has no event; and ported handlers with the (IsColumn, Index) signature do not compile.

what_it_does: One event pair for BOTH axes (IsColumn, AIndex, ASize) covering during-drag and after-drag.
ours_evidence: Ours splits into four: OnColumnSizing / OnEndColumnSize / OnRowSizing / OnEndRowSize (Grid.pas:1264-1267). grep -ri 'OnHeaderSiz' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1562-1563; published on TDrawGrid (:1688-1689) / TStringGrid (:1934-1935) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:274-275).
user_impact: Ported handlers must be split in two and re-registered on two properties each; the axis-agnostic form does not exist.

what_it_does: Fires when the button in a cbsButton / cbsEllipsis / cbsButtonColumn cell is pressed, with (aCol, aRow).
ours_evidence: Ours splits by kind: OnCellButtonClick (Grid.pas:1287) for gcdButton display cells and OnEllipsisClick (1296, type at 462-463 with var ANewText / var AAccept) for the gekEllipsis editor button. grep -ri 'OnButtonClick\|OnEditButtonClick' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1311 'property OnButtonClick: TOnSelectEvent ...', :1310 OnEditButtonClick (deprecated); published on TDrawGrid (:1676-1677) / TStringGrid (:1922-1923) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:251, 265).
user_impact: Two names to discover instead of one, and neither matches ported code.

what_it_does: Fires after a checkbox cell is toggled, with the new state.
ours_evidence: Ours is OnCheckBoxChange (Grid.pas:1291, type at 464-465: ACol, ARow, AChecked) - same shape, different name - plus the veto OnCanToggleCheck (1289). grep -ri 'OnCheckboxToggled' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1305 'property OnCheckboxToggled: TToggledCheckboxEvent ...'; published on TDrawGrid (:1664) / TStringGrid (:1910) / TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:253).
user_impact: Straight rename break on a commonly used event.

what_it_does: One event that transforms a cell's text on BOTH copy and paste (cpCopy / cpPaste discriminated by a parameter).
ours_evidence: Ours splits into OnClipboardCopy / OnClipboardPaste (whole-blob, Grid.pas:2247-2250) plus per-cell OnBeforePasteCell / OnAfterPasteCell (2251-2254). There is no per-cell hook on the COPY side - grep -ri 'OnCellProcess' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1798 'property OnCellProcess: TCellProcessEvent read fOnCellProcess write fOnCellProcess'; enum TCellProcessType at :184; published on TStringGrid (:1908).
user_impact: 'strip the currency symbol on copy' has to be done by rewriting the whole clipboard blob instead of per cell.

what_it_does: Horizontal wheel / tilt-wheel notifications.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnMouseWheelHorz\|OnMouseWheelLeft\|OnMouseWheelRight' over source/ returned nothing. Our base publishes only OnMouseWheel / OnMouseWheelUp / OnMouseWheelDown (tyControls.Base.pas:220-222) and the grid republishes nothing extra.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1701-1703 (TDrawGrid), :1947-1949 (TStringGrid), valedit.pas:287-289; the protected overrides at grids.pas:1039-1040.
user_impact: On a wide grid, a tilt-wheel or trackpad horizontal gesture cannot be observed by the host (and, since we never publish the events, cannot be redirected).

what_it_does: Last-chance hook to rewrite or suppress the hint just before it is shown.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnShowHint' over source/ hits only Chart.pas. Our base publishes Hint / ShowHint / ParentShowHint (tyControls.Base.pas:208-209, 230) but not OnShowHint, and the grid sets Hint directly (Grid.pas:8548-8549).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1958 'property OnShowHint;' (TStringGrid), valedit.pas:297.
user_impact: Hint text the grid computed (cell hint, comment) cannot be intercepted or positioned by the host.

what_it_does: Right-to-left layout: column order, text alignment and scrollbar side all mirror.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'BiDiMode\|RTL' over source/ returned nothing for the grid; our column axis is computed left-to-right only (ColumnLeftPx, Grid.pas:1016) with no mirroring hook.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:1847 'property BiDiMode;' (TStringGrid), :1886 ParentBiDiMode, valedit.pas:211, 232; the RTL machinery at grids.pas:975 (RTLSign), :1320-1322 (FlipRect/FlipPoint/FlipX), :1000 (CM_BIDIMODECHANGED).
user_impact: The control cannot be used in Arabic/Hebrew locales - the columns run the wrong way and there is no switch.

what_it_does: A whole per-column title object with its own Alignment, Caption, Color, Font, ImageIndex, ImageLayout, Layout (vertical), MultiLine and PrefixOption - so the header cell can be styled independently of the column's data cells.
ours_evidence: Ours flattens two of its nine members onto the column itself: Text (Columns.pas:94), CaptionAlignment (93) and ImageIndex (95). grep -ri 'GridColumnTitle\|property Title' over source/ returned nothing; there is no title sub-object, no per-title colour or font, no vertical title layout, no per-column multi-line title (only the grid-wide, non-published HeaderWordWrap at Grid.pas:1137), no image layout and no '&' prefix handling in titles.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:448-511 (TGridColumnTitle, published members at :502-510), :624 'property Title: TGridColumnTitle read FTitle write SetTitle'.
user_impact: A .lfm with Columns[n].Title.Caption / .Font / .MultiLine (the normal way LCL grid columns are configured in the designer) cannot be ported at all, and per-column header styling is only reachable through the OnGetHeaderStyle event.

what_it_does: Per-column cell background colour, streamed from the .lfm.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'per-column colour' n/a; TTyColumn published list (Columns.pas:87-98) has no Color, and TTyGridColumn's own published list (Grid.pas:255-292) adds none. Colour is per-CELL (CellColors, Grid.pas:2052), per-ROW (SetRowColor, 2057) or event-driven (OnGetCellStyle, 1255) - grep -ri 'SetColumnColor\|ColumnColor' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:613 'property Color: TColor read GetColor write SetColor stored IsColorStored'.
user_impact: 'shade the read-only columns grey' - a design-time, one-property job in LCL - requires either an event handler or writing a colour into every cell of the column (and re-writing it on every row insert).

what_it_does: Per-column cell font, streamed from the .lfm.
ours_evidence: TTyColumn (Columns.pas:87-98) and TTyGridColumn (Grid.pas:255-292) publish no Font. Font varies only via OnGetCellStyle's var AFontName/AFontSize/AFontWeight (Grid.pas:518-521) or the per-cell CellFontStyles (1892, styles only - bold/italic - not family or size).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:616 'property Font: TFont read GetFont write SetFont stored IsFontStored'.
user_impact: A monospaced amount column or a bold key column must be produced by an event handler; nothing about it can be set in the designer.

what_it_does: Per-column VERTICAL alignment of cell text (tlTop / tlCenter / tlBottom).
ours_evidence: TTyColumn has Alignment and CaptionAlignment (Columns.pas:92-93) - both TAlignment, i.e. horizontal only. Vertical alignment exists only as CellAppearance.VAlign, hard-defaulted to tlCenter (Grid.pas:4256) and changeable solely through OnGetCellStyle's var AVAlign (Grid.pas:521). grep -ri 'property Layout' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:617 'property Layout: TTextLayout read GetLayout write SetLayout stored IsLayoutStored'; the title twin at :508.
user_impact: On a tall, word-wrapped row, text cannot be top-aligned per column without writing an event handler - and never from the .lfm.

what_it_does: The exact strings this column's checkbox cells write and recognise for checked / unchecked (default '1' and '0'), so the grid matches the host's data vocabulary.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ValueChecked\|ValueUnchecked' over source/ returned nothing. Ours hard-codes the vocabulary in CellChecked / CellCheckState (Grid.pas:1877-1880) with one GLOBAL escape hatch, the unit-level var TyGridCheckedWord (Grid.pas:2304-2308) - one word for the whole application, not per column.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:627-630 'property ValueChecked: string ... property ValueUnchecked: string ...'; defaults at :585-586.
user_impact: A grid whose data says 'Y'/'N' in one column and 'true'/'false' in another cannot use checkbox cells correctly - toggling silently writes our vocabulary and corrupts the host's data.

what_it_does: Declares the column's in-cell control: cbsAuto, cbsEllipsis, cbsNone, cbsPickList, cbsCheckboxColumn, cbsButton, cbsButtonColumn - note the two '...Column' variants mean the control shows in EVERY cell of the column, not just the focused one.
ours_evidence: Ours is EditorKind: TTyGridEditorKind (Grid.pas:280, enum at 73-93) plus the orthogonal CellDisplay: TTyGridCellDisplay (275, enum at 60-70). The 'always show it in every cell' distinction that cbsCheckboxColumn / cbsButtonColumn carry is expressed only through CellDisplay=gcdButton, so a checkbox column that is always visible has to be set up in two places. grep -ri 'ButtonStyle\|TColumnButtonStyle' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:612 'property ButtonStyle: TColumnButtonStyle read FButtonStyle write SetButtonStyle default cbsAuto'; enum at :154-162; the factory EditorByStyle at :1345.
user_impact: A ported .lfm's ButtonStyle=cbsCheckboxColumn has to be translated into two of our properties, and there is no single property that describes 'what kind of column is this'.

what_it_does: How many items the column's pick-list shows before it scrolls.
ours_evidence: Ours has only DropDownWidth (Grid.pas:264, 'default 0') - the width, not the height. grep -ri 'DropDownRows' over source/ hits only Cascader.pas, not the grid or its columns.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:614 'property DropDownRows: Longint read FDropDownRows write FDropDownRows default 7'; also on TValueListEditor (valedit.pas:309, default 8).
user_impact: A pick list with 40 options either fills the screen or is fixed at whatever our code chose; the host cannot cap it.

what_it_does: Per-column weight used when AutoFillColumns distributes spare width; 0 means 'never auto-size me'.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'SizePriority' over source/ returned nothing. Ours has only the all-or-nothing flag coAutoSpring (Columns.pas:26) - and that flag is itself never read outside Columns.pas (see the AutoFillColumns entry).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:622 'property SizePriority: Integer read GetSizePriority write SetSizePriority stored IsSizePriorityStored'; DEFSIZEPRIORITY at :80; consumed by CalcAutoSizeColumn (:987).
user_impact: When the grid is resized, all stretchable columns must stretch equally; a layout like 'give the description column most of the slack' is not expressible.

what_it_does: The column's width bounds.
ours_evidence: Ours are MinWidth / MaxWidth (Columns.pas:89-90, defaults 10 / 10000). grep -ri 'MinSize\|MaxSize' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:618-619 'property MinSize: Integer ... property MaxSize: Integer ...'; DEFMINSIZE/DEFMAXSIZE at :78-79 (both 0 = unbounded).
user_impact: Rename break, plus a default difference: theirs default to 0 (unbounded) while ours default to 10 / 10000, so a ported column silently gains bounds.

what_it_does: Per-column visibility as its own published boolean.
ours_evidence: Ours hides it inside a set: coVisible in Options (Columns.pas:21-28, 96), with grid helpers HideColumn / ShowColumn / IsHiddenColumn (Grid.pas:937-939). grep -ri 'property Visible' in Columns.pas returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:626 'property Visible: Boolean read GetVisible write SetVisible stored IsVisibleStored'.
user_impact: Columns[i].Visible := False does not compile and does not appear as a checkbox in the column collection editor; the user has to find a set element instead.

what_it_does: Whether an expandable (grouped/parent) column is showing its child columns.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'property Expanded' over source/ returned nothing for columns; the only Expanded is TTyValueRow.Expanded (ValueListEditor.pas:35). Our header grouping (TTyGridHeaderGroup, Grid.pas:156-177) is a paint-only band with no collapse state.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:615 'property Expanded: Boolean read GetExpanded write SetExpanded default True'.
user_impact: Grouped column headers cannot be collapsed to hide their member columns.

what_it_does: A typed default array property and a typed Add, so column code reads Columns[3].Width := 40 with no casting.
ours_evidence: TTyColumns (Columns.pas:103-165) declares neither: no 'property Items', no 'function Add' (grep 'function Add' in Columns.pas returned nothing), so both come from TCollection typed as TCollectionItem. Our own code has to cast everywhere - e.g. Grid.pas:11455 'TTyColumn(Header.Columns.Items[cIdx]).Text' and 3317 'FHeader.Columns.ApplyAutoSize(...)'.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:670 'property Items[Index: Integer]: TGridColumn read GetColumn write SetColumn; default;', :661 'function Add: TGridColumn;'.
user_impact: Every line of ported column code needs a hard cast, and Columns[i] (the default-array form) does not compile at all - a constant tax on the most-touched part of the API.

what_it_does: Find a column by its header caption.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ColumnByTitle\|IndexOfCaption\|ColumnByText' over source/ returned nothing. TTyColumns offers only ColumnByPosition (visual slot, Columns.pas:130) and ColumnFromPosition (pixel X, 145).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:663 'function ColumnByTitle(const aTitle: string): TGridColumn;'.
user_impact: Code that addresses columns by name - the normal way to keep a CSV importer or a report generator independent of column order - must write its own scan.

what_it_does: Map between 'nth visible column' and 'nth collection item', count the visible ones, and bounds-check an index.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'VisibleCount\|VisibleIndex\|RealIndex\|HasIndex' over source/: VisibleCount hits only ListView.Layout/TreeView, the rest return nothing. Ours has the grid-level NextVisibleCol / FirstVisibleCol / LastVisibleCol (Grid.pas:941-944) but no count and no index translation, so every host loop must skip hidden columns by hand.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/grids.pas:664 RealIndex, :667 HasIndex, :668 VisibleIndex, :671 'property VisibleCount: Integer read GetVisibleCount'.
user_impact: 'export the 3rd visible column' or 'how many columns is the user actually seeing' each need a hand-written loop that must remember the coVisible rule.

what_it_does: The editor's entire data model published as a TStringList of 'Key=Value' lines: assignable in one statement, sortable, streamable, editable in the designer's string-list editor, and carrying a parallel ItemProps list.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'Strings' over tyControls.ValueListEditor.pas returned no such property (only unrelated identifiers). Our model is a hand-rolled tree of TTyValueRow objects (ValueListEditor.pas:19-46) built one call at a time via AddRow (174) / InsertRow (176), with no TStrings view in or out.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:81-100 (TValueListStrings), :314 'property Strings: TValueListStrings read FStrings write SetStrings'.
user_impact: 'VLE.Strings := MyIniSection' / 'MyList.Assign(VLE.Strings)' - the way a value-list editor is normally loaded and saved - has no counterpart, and the content cannot be entered at design time at all.

what_it_does: A per-row property object addressable BY KEY OR INDEX, carrying EditMask, EditStyle, KeyDesc, PickList, MaxLength and ReadOnly - the row's editing contract, separate from its value.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'ItemProps\|TItemProp' over source/ returned nothing. Our per-row settings are plain public fields on TTyValueRow (ValueListEditor.pas:26-35: EditorKind, EnumValues, ReadOnly, Bold, TextColor, ImageIndex, Expanded) reachable only through the TTyValueRow reference AddRow returned - there is no lookup by key (ChildByKey is private, ValueListEditor.pas:131) and no property object.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:22-52 (TItemProp, published members :46-51), :203 'property ItemProps[const AKeyOrIndex: Variant]: TItemProp read GetItemProp write SetItemProp'.
user_impact: Configuring a row after the fact ('make the Password row masked') requires having kept the row pointer; there is no VLE.ItemProps['Password'] path at all.

what_it_does: Per-row input mask, maximum input length, and a human-readable description of the key (shown instead of the raw key).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'EditMask' over source/ hits only Grid.pas:260 and MaskEdit.pas; 'MaxLength' hits ComboBox/Edit/Grid/Memo/SpinEdit - none in ValueListEditor.pas; 'KeyDesc' returns nothing anywhere. TTyValueRow has DisplayKey (ValueListEditor.pas:25) which covers KeyDesc's job under another name, but nothing for mask or length; the inline editor only restricts to numeric via TTyValueNumericMode (ValueListEditor.pas:53).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:46 EditMask, :50 MaxLength, :48 KeyDesc.
user_impact: A property inspector row that must accept a date, a phone number, or at most 8 characters cannot enforce it - the user types anything and validation happens (if at all) after the fact.

what_it_does: PickList is the row's drop-down options as a TStrings; EditStyle chooses esSimple / esEllipsis / esPickList.
ours_evidence: Ours are EnumValues: string ('options, one per line', ValueListEditor.pas:30) and EditorKind: TTyValueEditorKind (29, enum at 14-15: vekText/vekInteger/vekFloat/vekBoolean/vekEnum/vekColor/vekFont/vekDialog/vekReadOnly). Same jobs, different names and a string instead of a TStrings.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:49 'property PickList: TStrings read GetPickList write SetPickList', :47 'property EditStyle: TEditStyle read FEditStyle write SetEditStyle'; enum at :17.
user_impact: Ported code assigning a TStrings of options must be rewritten to build a newline-joined string; and the option list cannot be shared with any other TStrings consumer.

what_it_does: THEIRS: Values is indexed BY KEY - 'VLE.Values[''Name''] := ''Bob''' - the single most used member of the class. OURS: the identifier Values exists but is indexed by INTEGER row number, and the key-indexed accessor is called ValueOf.
ours_evidence: ValueListEditor.pas:202 'property Values[AIndex: Integer]: string read GetValue write SetValue' and :203 'property ValueOf[const AKey: string]: string read GetValueOf write SetValueOf'.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:202 'property Values[const Key: string]: string read GetValue write SetValue' (and Keys[Index: Integer] at :201 is the index-based one).
user_impact: The worst collision in this pairing: our Values takes exactly the parameter theirs does NOT. 'Values[''Name'']' fails to compile, and any numeric-looking key expression could compile against the wrong accessor and address the wrong row.

what_it_does: Read AND write the key (name) of row Index - renaming a row in place.
ours_evidence: Ours is read-only: ValueListEditor.pas:201 'property Keys[AIndex: Integer]: string read GetKey' - no writer, and no other rename path (grep for a SetKey / RenameRow over ValueListEditor.pas returned nothing).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:201 'property Keys[Index: Integer]: string read GetKey write SetKey'.
user_impact: A row's key can never be changed after creation; renaming means deleting and re-adding, which loses its position, children and per-row settings.

what_it_does: doColumnTitles shows a header row over the two columns, TitleCaptions supplies its two captions (localisable), doAutoColResize keeps the value column filling the width, doKeyColFixed freezes the key column; TitleFont styles the header.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'DisplayOptions\|TitleCaptions' over source/ returned nothing; 'TitleFont' hits only Popover.pas. Our editor has no header row at all - it renders only rows (PaintItemContent, ValueListEditor.pas:159) - and its only layout knob is KeyColumnWidth (206).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:306-307 'property DisplayOptions: TDisplayOptions ... default [doColumnTitles, doAutoColResize, doKeyColFixed]', :315 TitleCaptions, :242 TitleFont; enum at :106-107.
user_impact: LCL's DEFAULT includes doColumnTitles, so every ported value-list editor loses its 'Key | Value' header, and there is no way to label the two columns.

what_it_does: What the USER may do to the row set at run time: keyEdit (rename a key), keyAdd (Insert adds a row), keyDelete (Ctrl+Delete removes one), keyUnique (reject duplicate keys).
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'KeyOptions\|keyUnique' over source/ returned nothing. Our editor's KeyDown (ValueListEditor.pas:164) has no add/delete/rename handling; rows can only be added or removed from code (AddRow 174 / DeleteRow 183), and nothing checks for duplicate keys.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:310 'property KeyOptions: TKeyOptions read FKeyOptions write SetKeyOptions default []'; enum at :109-110; the duplicate-key message rsVLEDuplicateKey at :326.
user_impact: A user-editable name/value list (the classic ini or environment-variable editor) is impossible: the user can change values but never add, remove or rename an entry.

what_it_does: Fires with the row's key and a TStrings to fill, so the drop-down options are computed when the list opens.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnGetPickList' over source/ hits only the grid (Grid.pas:2240) - nothing in ValueListEditor.pas. Our options are the static EnumValues string set when the row is built (ValueListEditor.pas:30, consumed at 808).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:317 'property OnGetPickList: TGetPickListEvent read FOnGetPickList write FOnGetPickList'; type at :112-113.
user_impact: Options that depend on live state (the list of open documents, the current database's tables) cannot be offered - the row must be rebuilt to change its choices.

what_it_does: Fires with (ACol, ARow, KeyName, KeyValue) BEFORE a change is accepted, so the host can raise and reject.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnValidate' over source/ returned nothing. Ours only notifies AFTER the fact: OnValueChanged (ValueListEditor.pas:209, fired from CommitEditor, 128) and OnEditRow (211). There is no veto point.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:320 'property OnValidate: TOnValidateEvent read FOnValidate write FOnValidate'; type at :115-116; the override at :177.
user_impact: A bad value cannot be refused - the host can only detect it afterwards and write a correction back, which the user sees flicker.

what_it_does: Fire around any change to the whole row set (add, delete, sort, bulk assign), not just a single value edit.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'OnStringsChang' over source/ returned nothing. Ours fires only per-row: OnValueChanged (ValueListEditor.pas:209). Structural changes (AddRow 174, DeleteRow 183, Clear 177, UpdateRows 187) notify nobody.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:318-319 'property OnStringsChange: TNotifyEvent ... property OnStringsChanging: TNotifyEvent ...'.
user_impact: A dirty flag or a live preview cannot be driven off the editor - clearing and refilling it produces no notification at all.

member: FindRow(const KeyName: string; out aRow: Integer): Boolean
what_it_does: Locate the row index for a key.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'FindRow' over source/ returned nothing. Our key lookup is the PRIVATE ChildByKey (ValueListEditor.pas:131) and the value-only ValueOf (203); a host cannot get from a key to a row index or a TTyValueRow.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:186 'function FindRow(const KeyName: string; out aRow: Integer): Boolean;'.
user_impact: 'scroll to / start editing the row called X' cannot be written: BeginEdit takes a flat index (ValueListEditor.pas:191) and there is no way to obtain it from a key.

member: InsertRow(const KeyName, Value: string; Append: Boolean): Integer
what_it_does: Insert or append a row and RETURN its index; Append=False inserts at the current row.
ours_evidence: Ours is 'procedure InsertRow(const AKey, AValue: string)' (ValueListEditor.pas:176) - always appends (documented 'append a plain text root row'), returns nothing, and takes no Append flag. The row-returning variant AddRow (174) also always appends.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:188 'function InsertRow(const KeyName, Value: string; Append: Boolean): Integer;'.
user_impact: Same name, incompatible signature: ported calls fail, and inserting a row at a chosen position (rather than at the end) is not possible at all.

member: Sort / Sort(Index, IndxFrom, IndxTo) / Sort(ACol: TVleSortCol)
what_it_does: Sort the rows by key or by value (TVleSortCol = colKey, colValue), optionally over a range, keeping each row's ItemProps with it.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'Sort' over tyControls.ValueListEditor.pas returned nothing. Rows stay in insertion order; there is no sort of any kind.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:197-198 'procedure Sort(Index, IndxFrom, IndxTo: Integer); procedure Sort(ACol: TVleSortCol = colKey);'; enum at :18; the property-preserving sort at :86.
user_impact: A long property list cannot be alphabetised, which is the first thing users ask of a name/value editor.

what_it_does: Published read/write row count: settable to grow or trim the list, and streamable.
ours_evidence: Ours is a read-only public FUNCTION - ValueListEditor.pas:179 'function RowCount: Integer' ('Number of ROOT rows') - so it is neither settable nor visible to the designer. The visible-row count is a second function, VisibleRowCount (198).
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:237 'property RowCount: Integer read GetRowCount write SetRowCount' in the published section.
user_impact: 'VLE.RowCount := 10' does not compile, and RowCount cannot be read as a property (e.g. by RTTI or a binding layer).

what_it_does: Ask whether the current (or a given) row is blank, and undo the in-progress edit of the current row, restoring both its key and value.
ours_evidence: grep -ri 'IsEmptyRow\|RestoreCurrentRow' over source/ returned nothing. Our EndEdit(ACommit) (ValueListEditor.pas:154) can discard the editor's text but does not restore a key, and nothing reports emptiness.
theirs_evidence: C:/lazarus/lcl/valedit.pas:191-192 (two IsEmptyRow forms), :196 'function RestoreCurrentRow: Boolean;'.
user_impact: Escape-to-revert on a row being edited, and 'do not commit blank rows', both have to be hand-rolled.

what_it_does: A streamable, design-time-editable tree of TTreeNode objects: Items.AddChild(nil,'Root'), the OI 'TreeView Items Editor', nodes saved in the .lfm, Items.Count/Item[i]/TopLvlItems, Items.BeginUpdate/EndUpdate, Items.Clear.
ours_evidence: tyControls.TreeView.pas:57-68 declares TTyTreeNode as a plain record (Index, ChildCount, NodeHeight, States, Parent/sibling pointers) with no Text/owner; :186 TTyTreeView has no Items property at all (published list is :585-660). Node creation is only :463 `function AddChild(AParent: PTyTreeNode): PTyTreeNode` plus :596 `RootNodeCount`. grep -ri over source/ for a TTreeNode/TTreeNodes-style item class returned nothing; the only collection-based node model in the library is TTyTreeSelect/TTyColumns, not a node tree.
theirs_evidence: comctrls.pp:3206 TTreeNodes = class(TPersistent); :3248-3261 Add/AddChild/AddChildFirst/AddChildObject/AddFirst/AddNode/AddObject; :3276-3281 Insert/InsertBehind/InsertObject; :3297-3305 Count/Item[]/TopLvlCount/TopLvlItems; :3772 `property Items: TTreeNodes read FTreeNodes write SetTreeNodes` (published on TTreeView at :3856).
user_impact: A TTreeView can be filled in the designer and shipped in the .lfm; a TTyTreeView cannot be populated at all without writing OnGetText/OnInitNode code. Every ported unit that touches Tree.Items fails to compile.

what_it_does: Per-node caption stored on the node: Node.Text := 'x' / s := Node.Text.
ours_evidence: tyControls.TreeView.pas:57-68 the node record has no text field; the caption is only ever pulled from an event — :634 OnGetText / :635 OnGetTextWithType (fired at paint, see :3813 region). grep -ri 'Text' over source/ finds no per-node text storage for the tree (TTyListItem.Caption at tyControls.ListView.pas:81 is the list's, not the tree's).
theirs_evidence: comctrls.pp:3175 `property Text: string read FText write SetText`; setter at :3078 SetText, change notification ncTextChanged at :2911.
user_impact: Node captions cannot be set or read at all; every tree needs an OnGetText handler plus an app-side text store, so the simplest possible use (a static tree of labels) is impossible.

member: AddFirst / Insert / InsertBehind / AddChildFirst / AddNode(..., TNodeAttachMode) / Node.MoveTo
what_it_does: Create or relocate a node at a chosen position: as first child, before/behind a given sibling, or via naAdd/naAddFirst/naAddChild/naAddChildFirst/naInsert/naInsertBehind.
ours_evidence: tyControls.TreeView.pas:463 only `AddChild(AParent)` (appends as last child; implementation :2077). Relocation exists but only as :477 `MoveNode(ANode, ATarget, AMode)` with :40 TTyTreeDropMode = (dmNone, dmAbove, dmOn, dmBelow) — dmOn always appends as LAST child, so 'insert as first child' is unreachable. grep -ri 'AddFirst|InsertNode|AddChildFirst' over source/ returned nothing.
theirs_evidence: comctrls.pp:3250 AddChildFirst; :3255 AddFirst; :3256 AddNode(..., Method: TNodeAttachMode); :3276 Insert; :3277 InsertBehind; :2891-2898 TNodeAttachMode; :3144 TTreeNode.MoveTo(Destination, Mode).
user_impact: You cannot build a tree in any order but append-to-end, and cannot insert a node before an existing sibling — a sorted insert has to be done by rebuilding the level.

what_it_does: Suppresses repaint/relayout while a batch of nodes is added or changed, then does one update.
ours_evidence: grep -ril 'BeginUpdate' over source/ hits FontComboBox, FontListBox, Grid, ListView, MRUComboBox, ValueListEditor — NOT tyControls.TreeView.pas. The tree only has :382 InvalidateTreeLayout (private) and recomputes on every structural change (:2077 AddChild → InvalidateTreeLayout).
theirs_evidence: comctrls.pp:3725-3726 `procedure BeginUpdate; procedure EndUpdate;` on TCustomTreeView (and :3284/:3289 on TTreeNodes).
user_impact: Bulk-loading a tree repaints and re-measures per node; the classic BeginUpdate/EndUpdate wrapper every ported app uses does not compile.

what_it_does: Persist the whole node tree (text + image indices + expanded state) to a text file or stream and read it back.
